name: mios_ai_metadata
description: Strict OpenAI-compatible schema for MiOS native AI-hint and header metadata parsed from source files.

hint.description: Primary AI-hint describing file purpose and context.

related.description: Related services, files, ports, or documents.

doc.description: Associated documentation path if declared in AI-doc header.

comment_style.description: Comment syntax used (hash, slash, xml, semi, dash).

has_shebang.description: Whether file starts with an executable shebang.
